title: Golden composites: gate 'Single style' (3 heroines x 5 screens)
owner_gate: M7: owner looks at the 15 finals and approves/rejects per criteria a-e of GDD 11.4; a failed composite stops the rig pipeline (P42, P43)

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
assumptions: 1k medium = 1 cr, 2k high = 2 cr per image (quoted by estimate_image_cost, SPEC_V2 section 0)

candidates_policy: search: 8 candidates per frame at 1k medium (1 cr); final: 2 candidates of the best prompt at 2k high (2 cr)

criteria: a) faces distinguishable on >= 3 of 5 measurable traits (eye shape, face width, nose/mouth, apparent age, brows) across mc/yue/nova
b) heroine accent colour <= 20% of the frame area; UI chrome is lacquer / paper / gold only; Nova's neon lives only in her outfit and FX
c) one tile set across all five screens (blank ivory tiles)
d) gold reserved for SSR and one accent; no gold buttons
e) automatic head-count ruler 7-7.5 heads (measure, not eyeball)
anatomy double audit passed: crops of hands, fingers, legs and feet show no extra or fused limbs
face reads as the canon heroine (>= 4 of 5 traits: eye shape, face width, nose/mouth, apparent age, brows) vs the element portrait
hair colour, signature items and outfit match the canon card; no drift (hair_never rules)
no text, no logos, no watermark, no garbled glyphs anywhere; mahjong tiles blank

pilot.go_rule: 3 frames x 2 candidates: faces clearly different, no text, accent colour <= 20%

tool_note: gpt_image_2_6 + Higgsfield Elements (<<<element_id>>> in the prompt; do not also pass the element in medias). Environment is described in text; the LoRA v1/v2 environment variant is a later swap-in, see README.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.
